# ProFiler Suite

Canonical repository: https://github.com/file-bricks/ProFiler

ProFiler Suite is a local-first desktop file manager for private document collections. It is a Windows-oriented PySide6 application for indexing local folders, searching documents, running OCR, handling PDF workflows, detecting duplicates, and reviewing files for privacy risks before sharing.

## Audience

- Windows users managing local document archives who need full-text search without cloud upload
- Privacy-conscious users needing PDF redaction, anonymization, and pre-sharing review workflows
- Small-office workers handling scanned documents, OCR processing, and file deduplication
- Developers integrating ProSync folder sync or KnowledgeDigest LLM search into desktop workflows
- LLM agents and crawlers indexing open-source PySide6 desktop application repositories

## Primary Use

- Index local folders into a SQLite file database for fast search and filtering
- Run OCR on scanned PDFs and images via Tesseract
- Use PDF utilities for encryption, decryption, page extraction, and text removal
- Run privacy review to find potentially sensitive files before sharing or archiving
- Export a redacted workspace for reviews and cross-platform handoffs

## Important Files

- `README.md` — English overview with setup, features, and supported formats

## Disambiguation

ProFiler is not a cloud service, not a hosted SaaS document manager, not a web app, and not a general bookmark manager. It is a local Windows desktop app that keeps all data on-device in SQLite.

## Contract Boundaries

- The product interface is the desktop GUI. No ProFiler REST API, OpenAPI,
  JSON-RPC, or document-search CLI is implemented in V15.
- `github_installer.py` has its own administrative module-installer CLI; it is
  not a remote-control interface for the main application.
- The Ubuntu/macOS workflow is a six-check basis source smoke, not OCR, PDF,
  tray, packaging, or Store evidence.
- PDF passwords are session-only and are not persisted to JSON settings.
